# cm_run_task (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cm_run_task" "example" {
  name = "My Run Task"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the run task.
- `name` (String) The name of the run task.
